meta.title: KINESIS AI — Enterprise-Grade Private AI for Business
meta.description: KINESIS AI runs 100% on your office hardware: reads, classifies and answers with citations from contracts, invoices and reports. Data never leaves the building.

hero.titleA: Ask anything about your business documents.
hero.sub: KINESIS AI runs entirely on a secure, custom-designed server installed inside your office. It reads, sorts, and generates answers from your contracts, invoices, and reports using a local AI model. Stop uploading sensitive company data to public AI. Your documents never leave the building. You own it, you control it.

qa.q: Did we pay the January electricity invoice for the Saigon office?
qa.a: Yes. Outbound payment of 14,500,000 VND was recorded on January 12th. The receipt is attached.

qa.q: What are the termination terms for the HR labor contract?
qa.a: Requires 45 days written notice. Severance pay is calculated at 1 month salary per year of service.

qa.q: Find the clause about late payment penalties in the Truong Son contract.
qa.a: A penalty of 0.05% per day applies to overdue payments, not exceeding 8% of the total contract value.

product.title: Turn your documents into a smart knowledge base
product.lead: Turn thousands of scattered PDFs, scans, and Excel files into a single, highly secure knowledge base.

f1.title: Absolute Privacy, Security & Control
f1.text: KINESIS runs on a dedicated workstation with no internet connection required. Unlike other tools that send text to cloud AI for processing and generating replies, KINESIS uses local AI and tools. We validate PDF structures to block malicious files, keeping your network safe. You own it, you control it.

f2.title: Reads the Unreadable
f2.text: Blurry scans? Upside-down pages? Complex accounting tables that other software turns into garbage? Our custom engine automatically levels and straightens pages, verifies digital signatures, and perfectly reads multilingual text and complex tables.

f3.title: Cited Answers, Zero Guessing
f3.text: Every answer points to the exact file and page. If the information isn't in your documents, the system explicitly says 'I don't know'—it never invents facts.

f4.title: True Full-Document Context
f4.text: Unlike basic AI tools that only read the first page, KINESIS reads and summarizes the entire document, even if it's hundreds of pages long. You get a complete, accurate understanding of every file in your archive.

f5.title: Dual-Lingual Core (VN & EN)
f5.text: Interact with the system natively in Vietnamese or English. If your archive contains documents in other languages (like Russian), KINESIS preserves the original text perfectly for retrieval while communicating with you in VN or EN.

f6.title: Easy Local Interface
f6.text: Fully wrapped in a Docker container with a local web interface. No command lines, no complicated setup—your team accesses the AI securely through their browser.

how.title: A turnkey appliance. Live in 1-2 days.
how.lead: We handle the hardware engineering, the software deployment, and the setup. You just ask the questions.

s1.title: 1. We Engineer the Hardware
s1.text: You don't buy a random PC. We custom-build, assemble, and configure a high-performance, whisper-quiet AI workstation for your office.

s2.title: 2. Connect Your Folders
s2.text: Point KINESIS AI to your document folders. The system will scan, read, and classify everything automatically overnight.

s3.title: 3. Ask Questions
s3.text: Type a normal question. The AI instantly filters through thousands of files, finding the exact clauses, invoices, or data you need.

s4.title: 4. Get Cited Answers
s4.text: Receive a precise answer in seconds, with a citation linking directly to the original file.

q1.a: As a fully configured Docker container running on a custom-built AI workstation. We handle the hardware engineering, software deployment, and network setup. You just open your browser and start asking questions.

q2.a: Physical setup takes 1–2 days. The AI will then read and index your historical files overnight (about 1,000 documents per night). Daily updates happen automatically in the background.

q3.t: What if the answer isn't in my documents?
q3.a: KINESIS AI is programmed to be strictly factual. If the data doesn't exist in your archive, it will explicitly tell you it doesn't know. It never makes things up.

q4.t: Can we use government grants for this?
q4.a: Many Vietnamese businesses are eligible for digital transformation grants (like the HCMC DXCenter program). We can guide you on the application process, but the final approval and funding amount are determined by the government, not by us.

q5.a: Yes. KINESIS is specifically engineered to detect and read official digital signatures on Vietnamese government and commercial documents (which many standard IT systems fail to verify), as well as recognizing company stamps on scanned papers.

q6.t: Does KINESIS use ChatGPT or OpenAI?
q6.a: No. KINESIS runs open-weight AI models (like Qwen and Gemma) entirely on your local server. We do not connect to OpenAI or any external API. This means zero API fees, absolute privacy, and full offline capability.

q7.t: Do you use any external APIs to build the database?
q7.a: No. The entire pipeline—including text extraction, OCR, classification, and embedding generation—runs completely offline on your local hardware. We use open-source embedding models locally. No data is ever sent to third-party APIs like OpenAI, Google, or AWS during the database build or query process.

q8.t: I saw a similar system online for $1,500. Why is yours more expensive?
q8.a: You are comparing two completely different products. A $1,500 system is a basic cloud wrapper with zero customization. It fails on complex tables and messy scans. More importantly, it comes with hidden monthly API fees plus per-page processing fees (often charging extra for tables/images in DOCX files). KINESIS is 100% local. We do the hard engineering—custom OCR, complex table extraction, and page leveling—tailored to your exact workflows. You pay once for total control, with zero ongoing processing fees.

about.title: Hardcore engineering, not just software.

about.p2: We handle the entire stack—from writing the custom document-processing software to building the physical workstation. You talk directly to the engineer who builds your system.
